'''Robert Sekerka''' (born 1937) is an American physicist who is currently the University Professor Emeritus at [[Carnegie Mellon University]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cmu.edu/physics/people/faculty/sekerka.html|title=Robert Sekerka|publisher=cmu.edu|accessdate=April 29, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://sekerkaweb.phys.cmu.edu/|title=Robert Sekerka|publisher=cmu.edu|accessdate=April 29, 2017}}</ref>
